scope: New candidate startup-controlled diagnostic design; original protocol and v1 execution manifest unchanged. True preflight_complete describes preparation identity checks, not RNG/execution approval or future live gates.

reservation.policy: Keep finite preallocated headroom; check allocation and live free space before every arm. This is not exclusive capacity for output writes and cannot defeat concurrent writers; ENOSPC invalidates diagnosis and stops, never retries.

comparison_policy.A_vs_historical: Exact full original S07 business receipt result equality; unavailable old internals are not invented. A now means legacy business code under newly disclosed controlled initialization, not old trajectory recovery.
comparison_policy.A_vs_B: Exact full business receipt equality. No normalization or post-hoc exclusions.
comparison_policy.B_vs_C: Full pinned v2 semantic and array-integrity comparison, zero exclusions, hard60s
comparison_policy.before_C: B must match A and pass complete observer evidence validation before C starts.
comparison_policy.helpers: B complete capture helper30s; C full BC comparison helper60s. Accepted process gate, no witness calls.
known_limits: Actual auxiliary output path differences may still cause strict comparison hold; no path normalization authorized.
Matching initial RNG removes one confounder; it is not runtime noninterference proof.
A controlled initialization can change historical output; any difference remains mismatch_hold.
comparison_policy.parent_import_disclosure: stdlib-only diagnostic_storage control modules enter parent during assessment; target controlled import probe must confirm RNG/hash/thread/CUDA invariants.

open_gates: Explicit user acceptance of recorded startup condition and one manifest-bound finite S07 launch
Controller repeats all live identity/storage/thread/CUDA guards before each arm

launch_command_spec.scope: One source pair per A/B/C, at most6 logical witnesses, each pair1200s, no retry; B validation30s, full BC comparison60s; overall work cap3600s.

import_order_acceptance.role: new Adapter technical disposition; proposed launch approval must explicitly accept this condition

authorization_requirement.manifest_sha256: exact final launch file SHA required
authorization_requirement.note: Explicit new user approval is required despite launch-eligible manifest flags. Existing RNG decision approval persists.

overall_supervision.implementation: GNU timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=5s 3600s; Python KeyboardInterrupt uses existing fork/process transport cleanup to terminate and reap active child groups
overall_supervision.expiry_outcome: HOLD and stop; zero retry; receipt may be incomplete if forced kill required
overall_supervision.limitations: Normal interrupt cleanup is regression tested; kernel-uninterruptible processes cannot be guaranteed synchronously reaped.

capture_identity_semantics: adapter_identity.run_manifest_sha256 binds adapter_run_identity_v1.json immutable descriptor. The complete launch manifest SHA is separately bound by new authorization and controller receipt. Descriptor hashes are not runtime RNG state.

adapter_limits.logical_events: no legacy2M cap; bounded physical storage and existing Codec limits; no event sampling
adapter_limits.implementation: Pinned ObserverAdapter/Codec defaults; legacy Observer config is absent from this launch manifest.

revision_reason: Remove inherited unused legacy Observer limits, including the old2M event cap. New Controller uses pinned Adapter defaults. No source code changed and no real diagnostic has executed.
